children: Q32 Bio appointed José Trevejo as Chief Medical Officer and Ellie Hershberger as Chief Development Officer as it prepares to advance bempikibart into a registration-directed program.
Appointed José Trevejo, M.D., Ph.D., as Chief Medical Officer to lead clinical strategy and late-stage development.
Appointed Ellie Hershberger, Pharm.D., as Chief Development Officer to oversee late-stage development operations and regulatory strategy.
Leadership hires align with plan to advance bempikibart into a registration-directed program for severe/very severe alopecia areata.
Company cites encouraging Part B SIGNAL‑AA Phase 2a results showing meaningful regrowth, early durability and favorable tolerability.
